第1491章 地府来天竺国抓人了（第1页）
唐僧师徒离开了禁食领地，进入了一片新的领地。
“猴哥，我怎么感觉哪里有些不对？”
只见上百名阴差压着数百名鬼魂向着远处走去。
是的，正常情况下，天竺国是见不到阴差的。
原因非常的简单，这里有很多的天神。
有些天神就代替了黑白无常的位置，当然也有了许多暗箱操作的原因。
因为有的人，原本是要轮回转世的，可是他生前用大量的钱财贿赂了苦行僧。
死后直接被苦行僧封为最低等的野神。
当然，大多数情况下，生前就有可能成神。
当然他们也不会离开天竺宫的范围，玉皇大帝对这件事情，也是睁一只眼闭只眼。
毕竟天竺国有太多的乱子了，导致地府的账对不上，只不过是一件小事罢了。
千百年来，地府的阴差也没来过天竺国。
“哎哟喂，大圣爷爷，差一点可把小的吓死了！”
要知道眼前这位主，也是他们不能招惹的存在。
“我记得你们两人的工作范围不在这里！”
孙悟空好奇地问道：“大圣，您不知道，现在规矩变了！”
“凡是天竺国的死者，由我们地府的人来抓。”
白无常一脸苦相地说道：天竺国是凡间人口最多的国度，占总人口的半数以上。
原本这部分业务是不归黑白无常管的。
可是现在九凤命令下来，他们只能来天竺国来抓人了。
而且天竺国经常死人，工作量直接翻了十几倍。
“之前后土娘娘在地府和天道打了一架！”
虽然他经常去地府，但是圣人还真的没见过。
“具体什么事情我们兄弟两人也说不清楚！”
“但是可以肯定的是后土娘娘赢了，像地府的地位提升了不少，我们现在都可以来天竺国了。”
白无常无奈地说道：一下子增加了这么多的工作量，可以说是全年无休。
孙悟空陷入了沉思，百思不得其解。
“大圣，我们两人还需要回去复命，我们就先走了！”
“毕竟今天是第1天，来天竺国出任务，要是耽误了时间，上面可不好看。”
孙悟空挥了挥手，示意对方可以离开了，很明显他们知道的事情也不多。
看到孙悟空返回，唐僧上前一步问道：“师傅，地府好像发生了大变动，现在地府的人都来天竺国抓人了。”

Chapter 1491 The underworld has come to Tianzhu to arrest people (page 1)
Tang Seng and his disciples left the fasting territory and entered a new territory.
"Brother Monkey, why do I feel like something is wrong?"
I saw hundreds of ghosts suppressing hundreds of ghosts and walking towards the distance.
Yes, under normal circumstances, there is no chance of any evil in Tianzhu.
The reason is very simple, there are many gods here.
Some gods have taken the place of black and white, and of course there are many reasons for black-and-white operations.
Because some people were originally going to be reincarnated, but they bribed ascetics with a lot of money during their lifetime.
After his death, he was directly named as the lowest wild god by ascetics.
Of course, in most cases, it is possible to become a god while still alive.
Of course, they would not leave the confines of Tianzhu Palace. The Jade Emperor also turned a blind eye to this matter.
After all, there are too many troubles in Tianzhu country, and it is just a small matter that causes the underworld's accounts to not be reconciled.
For thousands of years, the underworld has never visited Tianzhu.
"Hey, Great Sage Grandpa, I almost scared the little one to death!"
They must know that the Lord in front of them is also an existence they cannot provoke.
"I remember that the scope of your work is not here!"
Sun Wukong asked curiously: "Great Sage, you don't know that the rules have changed now!"
"All the dead people in Tianzhu Kingdom will be captured by our people from the underworld."
Bai Wuchang said with a grimace: Tianzhu is the country with the largest population in the world, accounting for more than half of the total population.
Originally, this part of the business was not under the control of Black and White.
But now that Jiufeng has given the order, they can only come to Tianzhu to arrest people.
Moreover, people in Tianzhu often died, and the workload increased by more than ten times.
"Earlier, Empress Tu had a fight with Heaven in the underworld!"
Although he often goes to the underworld, he has never seen a saint.
"We brothers can't tell you exactly what it is!"
"But what is certain is that Empress Houtu won. The status of the underworld has been improved a lot. Now we can all come to Tianzhu."
Bai Wuchang said helplessly: "The workload has increased so much at once, it can be said that it is all year round."
Sun Wukong fell into deep thought and was puzzled.
"Great Sage, the two of us still need to go back to recover, so we'll leave first!"
"After all, today is the first day. I am on a mission in Tianzhu country. If I am delayed, it will not look good up there."
Sun Wukong waved his hand, indicating that the other party could leave. It was obvious that they didn't know much.
Seeing Sun Wukong return, Tang Monk stepped forward and asked: "Master, there seems to have been a big change in the underworld. Now the people from the underworld have come to Tianzhu to arrest people."
